definitions: The use of an office or other working environment by people who are self-employed or working for different employers, typically so as to share equipment, ideas, and knowledge.
A business center that provides shared office space and amenities to independent professionals and small businesses.
examples: The rise of coworking spaces has transformed how many startups operate.
She found a great sense of community in her coworking environment.
Many freelancers prefer coworking to working from home.
The company offers flexible coworking memberships.
